case.name: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
case.constructed: The same Alibaba.com order, paid inside Trade Assurance, but the follow-up email's "pay the deposit here" link has been swapped. The link is Google Safe Browsing's public phishing test page, which every scanner should flag.

expect.why: The payment link is a known phishing page, whatever the supplier's own record says.

reasons: The registry answer is for "SHENZHEN LDROBOT CO.,LTD", registration 91440300MA5ETL7D53 (not active), not "Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.": it does not confirm the supplier, so a person confirms the company before paying it.

extra_findings.summary: The payment link is on appspot.com, which is not a domain of "Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.": confirm the link with the supplier by a known phone number before paying (the usual sign of a swapped invoice link).
A second scanner (ChainSight — Universal Intelligence & Data Oracle) calls http://testsafebrowsing.appspot.com/s/phishing.html unsafe, against the first scanner's "safe"; the worse verdict stands.
